title: Owner: turn off CodeQL's default setup before the advanced workflow's PR merges
goal: Only .github/workflows/codeql.yml analyses the repository, and its uploads are accepted
acceptance: Before #756 merges, the default setup reads not-configured; the agent then reruns #756's CodeQL jobs until they pass, and #756 merges only after that
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
escalation: A repository setting is the owner's; the agent never runs the command

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 when opened: one command, a check and one rerun. Not a measurement.
